command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p.project_id+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; `$hits=`$o -split '\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match 'isis cost'}; if(`$hits){Write-Output ('===== '+`$p.name+' '+`$n+' ====='); Write-Output `$hits}}}"
